changeSet.author: Emmanuel Nnajiofor
changeSet.comment:
Self-heals databases where hts_encounter.last_modified_date is missing.
Background: the column was originally added in updates.xml (Updates installer, @Order 3), guarded by a tableExists(hts_encounter) precondition with onFail=MARK_RAN. hts_encounter is only created later by HtsEncounterSchemaInstaller (@Order 20), so on fresh installs and on upgrades from the legacy hts_client-era module that changeset was marked as run without ever adding the column, and was never retried. The HtsEncounter entity maps the column, so every query on hts_encounter then failed with "column last_modified_date does not exist".
This installer runs after hts_encounter is guaranteed to exist (@Order 27) and is fully idempotent. It deliberately has NO MARK_RAN precondition: if the table is somehow missing it fails loudly instead of being silently recorded as done.

changeSet.author: Emmanuel Nnajiofor
changeSet.comment: Mirrors 18-08-2026-fix-pregnancy-status-breastfeeding-concat (updates.xml), which was skipped on databases where hts_encounter did not exist when the Updates installer ran. Rows are only touched when pregnancyStatus still contains ' BREASTFEEDING_' or is a bare numeric codeset id and differs from the corrected value, so it is a no-op where the fix was already applied.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter e SET observation = jsonb_set(e.observation, '{pregnancyStatus}', to_jsonb(v.new_value), false), date_modified = now(), last_modified_date = now() FROM ( SELECT c.id, CASE WHEN c.prefix ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN coalesce( (SELECT k.code FROM base_application_codeset k WHERE k.id::text = c.prefix AND k.code LIKE 'PREGANACY!_STATUS!_%' ESCAPE '!'), c.prefix) WHEN c.prefix != '' THEN c.prefix WHEN c.breastfeeding = 'YES' AND c.is_female THEN 'PREGANACY_STATUS_BREASTFEEDING' ELSE '' END AS new_value FROM ( SELECT e2.id, btrim(split_part(e2.observation->>'pregnancyStatus', ' BREASTFEEDING_', 1)) AS prefix, upper(btrim(split_part(e2.observation->>'pregnancyStatus', ' BREASTFEEDING_', 2))) AS breastfeeding, (upper(btrim(coalesce(p.sex, ''))) LIKE '%FEMALE%' OR upper(btrim(coalesce(p.sex, ''))) = 'F') AS is_female FROM hts_encounter e2 LEFT JOIN patient_person p ON p.id = e2.patient_id WHERE e2.observation IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(e2.observation->'pregnancyStatus') = 'string' AND (strpos(e2.observation->>'pregnancyStatus', ' BREASTFEEDING_') != 0 OR btrim(e2.observation->>'pregnancyStatus') ~ '^[0-9]+$') ) c ) v WHERE e.id = v.id AND coalesce(e.observation->>'pregnancyStatus', '') IS DISTINCT FROM v.new_value;
